messages:
hannah: Heads-up: Weve got the Mid-City Meetup in 3 weeks. Thread to lock booth ops, speaker handoffs, swag counts, and lead routing. Prefer concise checklist.
ajay: Ill run stage timing and greenroom. Need a volunteer brief and a one-slide cue deck for MC.
marina: Volunteers: 5 people + floater. I've added a tentative shift sheet here: https://bit.ly/midcity-vol-roster
sophie: Can design produce a laminated volunteer dos/don't sheet and a 2-sided booth placard with QR for demos? Copy: short form only.
design-team: We can do that. Deliverables: volunteer sheet + 18x24 placard + badge lanyard art. ETA Thurs EOD. Need final copy and logo variants.
ryan: Swag plan: 2 premium items (enamel pin, tech tee) + 3 smalls (stickers, note pads, chapstick). Target inventory: 200 premium tees, 400 smaller items. Also want a small raffle box for collecting cards.
lina: Ordering now. Tee sizes: S-XL ratio 1:2:1:1. Shipping ETA 9 business days. Square reader will be on site for demo merch.
ajay: Speaker slots: 6 talks, 15min + 5min Q, 10min buffer after every pair. Greenroom checklist chalkboard with live run order please. Hannah can you confirm final schedule?
hannah: Final schedule in drive. Speakers should check-in 45 minutes prior, 15 minute tech check. MC to do a final call 3 minutes before stage.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit load-in permit to VenueOps by 1978654600 for ramp access.
marina: Permit submitted, ref VEN-4312. Requested 5 vendor parking passes.
sophie: Lead capture: QR badge -> short form. Must include consent checkbox. Auto-tag campaign: midcity-meetup. Post-event: 24hr first-touch email, tag MQLs and route to SDR queue.
ryan: Add a qualification question: "Are you evaluating inference infra in next 6 months?" (yes/no) to help SDR routing.
lina: Adding GDPR/legal consent checkbox. Also packing: secure crate for premium swag with padlock.
hannah: Post-event owner list: ajay = greenroom & export, marina = volunteer ops & notes, lina = swag orders, design-team = print assets, sophie = 24hr email. Anyone confirm?
ajay: Confirmed. I'll handle export + dedupe.
sophie: Draft 24hr follow-up email in /marketing/campaigns/midcity/email-1.md by Monday. Will include link to benchmark blog and demo sign-up.
design-team: Also making a small booth poster with a one-line benchmark teaser. Draft copy: "Redwood Inference  predictable latency, lower cost." Thoughts?
hannah: Shorten: "Predictable LLM inference. Lower cost. Production-ready"
marina: Kit handoff: pre-bagged speaker kits in numbered totes. Checklist in each tote: "mic pack, power brick, speaker badge, stage notes, water". Volunteer signs out kit and initials.
ryan: Label totes by time block A-E. Volunteer lead to initial return.
lina: Ops will keep 50 extra tees in locked bin. Do not leave premium swag unattended.
ops-bot: /remind @volunteers "Booth check-in 30 minutes before event" at 1978654800
hannah: Run a 30-minute rehearsal 48 hours prior with MC + AV. I'll book space.
ajay: I'll bring spare HDMI, XLR, and a backup laptop.
sophie: For social/benchmark narrative: collect 3 quick stats (attendees at booth, number of MQLs, a short technical quote) for a social post and blog blurb. Who will capture?
marina: I'll take live notes and upload a recap doc by EOD.
hannah: Final: confirm HubSpot form auto-tags campaign=midcity-meetup so routing works.
ops-bot: System: HubSpot form parameter verified.
ryan: Anything else? Do we have a portable charging hub for demo laptops? Need 3 ports.
marina: Ops has a 6-port charger, bringing it.
sophie: We're set. Closing this thread  we'll reconvene after rehearsal for final changes. :tada:
